I’ve taken my Maisy (Russian Borzoi) to Wag for grooming five times now, and every visit has been a great experience. Filipa is always gentle, professional and attentive, and she takes amazing care of my dog.
A Borzoi’s coat requires proper care and attention, and I’m always very happy with the results. She comes out looking beautiful, clean and perfectly smelled every time.
After five visits, I can confidently say that Wag is a place I trust with my Maisy. Highly recommended!

Thank you!! Love our Ralf days ♥️ Bravest and kindest boy!
Very attentive and professional.

Filipa takes care of every dog as if they they were her own, and that says everything you need to know about Wag. Everything is impeccable: from the service and the store, to the care and attention given to every dog that walks through the door. I couldn’t recommend Filipa and Wag more. Oh, and she has the cutest co-owners, Vilma and Roger! ☺️♥️
Best grooming in town!

Filipa at Wag Collective takes great care of our two Golden Retrievers each time we leave them with her. She is friendly and genuinely cares about the health and cleanliness of our dogs. We don't have a car, so getting them to the groomer is difficult; her pick up and drop off service is a life saver. A recent experience- she noticed one of our dogs was developing an infection in his ear and recommended we get him seen by his vet. She also noticed he is sensitive when being brushed, so she sent us a new brush recommendation. She goes above and beyond to make sure the dogs are happy and healthy.  She is friendly and we feel very comfortable leaving our dogs with her, knowing they're going to get the best treatment. Thanks Filipa!

I am writing this review following an incident that occurred on September 1, 2026, regarding an online appointment I had made for my dog, a Chow Chow.

After waiting approximately three weeks for the appointment, I went to Wag Collective with our dog and was simply informed by Ms. Filipa David that they do not bathe Chow Chows. No questions were asked about my dog's temperament, behavior, grooming history, or relationship with people and other animals. The refusal was immediate and based solely on breed.

The website presents a philosophy of humane grooming, stating that each dog is treated with patience, affection, and respect for its individuality. It also states that they adapt to dogs with different personalities and even work with nervous or rescued dogs, using positive reinforcement, pauses, and a gradual adaptation to the grooming process.

Regarding aggressive dogs, the information provided is clear: they cannot accept dogs with serious aggression problems, something I perfectly understand and consider absolutely legitimate, given the safety of the professionals, the other animals, and everyone present in the space.

However, this situation does not apply to my dog. And, more importantly, no one even tried to understand if it did.

My dog ​​was not evaluated, no questions were asked about his temperament, and there wasn't even an attempt to understand his individual behavior. The only information used as a basis for the refusal was the fact that he is a Chow Chow.

My dog ​​is five years old and has always been bathed in grooming salons. He is used to being handled by other people, frequents dog farms where he stays for several days when I go on vacation, interacts with other animals and different people, and I have never had any problems related to aggression or behavior.

A breed, by itself, does not define an animal's behavior. Just as there are dogs of breeds traditionally considered more sociable that can exhibit aggressive behavior, there are dogs of breeds with certain characteristics or reputations that are perfectly balanced and sociable.

In fact, during a phone conversation with my wife, it was confirmed that they accept dogs of other breeds that, in Portugal, are legally classified as potentially dangerous, including Pitbulls, evaluating them as individuals and not just based on breed. Therefore, I cannot understand why this same principle is not applied to Chow Chows.

What bothers me most in this situation is not the fact that they, as a company, can define their own service criteria. I perfectly understand that each business establishes its own rules and limits. What I question is the lack of transparency and the inconsistency between these criteria and what is publicly communicated by the brand.

If there is a policy excluding a particular breed, this information should be clearly indicated at the time of booking and on the website. I made this appointment believing in the inclusive, individualized, and humanized philosophy they present. I took my dog ​​to the location and, after weeks of waiting, I was confronted with a refusal based solely on breed, without any individual assessment.

Meanwhile, and after our phone conversation, Ms. Filipa David made a change to the website on September 4, 2026, specifically stating that they do not bathe Chow Chows older than 6 months. Unfortunately, there is much more to describe about this sad episode; however, this review has limited space, so the rest has been reported to the competent authorities responsible for monitoring and applying fines for misleading advertising.
A welcoming space and excellent grooming! I highly recommend it.
A 5-star job, of extremely high quality, coupled with great friendliness. Adding to that the affection shown to my dog, the result was a service of rare quality. It's worth the price. Thank you.
5 stars service

Impeccable service! Both the bath/grooming and the customer service. Lua Maria always leaves happy.

Marty looked amazing!!! Super fragrant and stylish 😁 He even brought a new accessory.

They arrive smelling great and happy.
I recommend them.
Excellent!
Thank you, Natacha 🙏 We loved the honey! …

I highly recommend it and it's my new favorite place 🥰
thank you! you’re amazing! my dog is happy!
Super friendly and loving! They treated my furry friend very well.

Thank you sooo much for looking after brioche!!
The service was very attentive, the space was very pleasant and welcoming, and the service was 5 stars. A true canine spa!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Excellent service! From the first contact to the final result, everything was impeccable. The team demonstrates incredible professionalism and, above all, a genuine affection for animals. The grooming was perfect — super well-treated fur, impeccable cut, and my furry friends left happy, relaxed, and smelling wonderful. It's clear that they work with dedication, experience, and love for what they do.

I recommend it 100%! I will certainly return.
Filipa attended to us with a last-minute reservation and dedicated 3 hours and 30 minutes to our Chilli, who had a matted coat. This on a Sunday at lunchtime! Top Top
The service was very friendly and professional. The Skipper loved it!

Filipa is very sweet and Gabriela has a super loving way of handling my skittish cat, who is actually a very calm 10-month-old Persian, but hates having his nails trimmed and even less having him brushed. We will be back. 😍😻 …

Everything was ready and carefully done. A good experience. I'd repeat it.
My Boogie 🐶 loved the experience, and so did I. I highly recommend it! ❤️🙌🏻 …
